annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2025/63 of 15 January 2025 on reviewing outbound investments in technology areas critical for the economic security of the Union
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2025/63 of 15 January 2025 on reviewing outbound investments in technology areas critical for the economic security of the Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Recommendation asking Member States to review and risk-assess outbound investments in advanced semiconductors, AI (large generative models above 10^25 FLOPs, or bio/space/defence-oriented) and quantum technologies, to address technology leakage and economic security risks. Sets reporting deadlines of July 2025 and June 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States should review outbound investments in semiconductors, AI and quantum technologies.
AI scope covers generative models trained with more than 10^25 FLOPs or for biotech, space or defence use.
Transactions covered include acquisitions, mergers, asset transfers, greenfield, joint ventures and venture capital since 1 January 2021.
Member States perform case-by-case risk assessments using a common methodology via the Expert Group.
Progress update due 15 July 2025; comprehensive report due 30 June 2026; single contact points by 15 March 2025.
